fields.description: Vietnamese unique Medieval era ranged unit that replaces the Crossbowman. These units have additional movement and can move after attacking. They are also stronger when defending, more expensive, and have greater sight.

summary: 40 strength, 3 moves, cost 100.

name: Impi
summary: Unique to Zulu, replaces Pikeman; 45 strength, 2 moves, cost 125; requires Military Tactics.

fields.description: Zulu unique Medieval Era unit that replaces the Pikeman. Increased Flanking bonus, low cost and low maintenance. Earns XP faster.
